lines.zh: 长腿踩在干河床上，沙沙响。
lines.en: Long legs rasp over the dry riverbed.

lines.zh: 我护着身后的蛋，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I shift slowly, guarding the eggs behind me.

lines.zh: 我的羽冠在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: My crest shines in the sun.
I walk the dune edge.

lines.zh: 每一步都要先看看四周。
lines.en: Every step begins with a look around.
I stretch my neck and walk warily.

lines.zh: 干的冲积土很松，我陷下去。
lines.en: Loose alluvium. My feet sink.

lines.zh: 羽毛擦着灌木发出细响。
lines.en: My feathers rasp the bushes.
I step around another's nest.
I walk a straight line, as if patrolling.

lines.zh: 脚趾抓着沙，每一步都稳。
lines.en: Toes grip the sand. Each step holds.

lines.zh: 我在巢和灌木之间来回走。
lines.en: I pace between the nest and the brush.

lines.zh: 我抬腿的时候会停一下。
lines.en: I pause each time I lift a leg.

lines.zh: 我回头看巢里有没有动静。
lines.en: I look back for movement in the nest.
Wind pushes sand into my feathers.
I follow the dried channel.
I crouch by the nest, wings half spread.
The eggs lie quiet under the sand.
I curl my neck into a loop.
My feathers flutter in the wind.
I listen under the sand.
An insect crawls past. I do not move.
The sun has made the sand hot.

lines.zh: 我抬头看远处的地平线。
lines.en: I look at the distant horizon.
I guard this clutch. I cannot leave.
I settle a little lower.
I have swept the sand flat by the nest.

lines.zh: 我趴在蛋上，听里面的动静。
lines.en: I lie over the eggs, listening inside.
Do not come near this nest.
I step forward, you step back.
There are three eggs here.
Your shadow is on the nest.
My wings are spread.
If you do not leave, I will not yield.
My neck is longer than before.
I have held this dune a long while.
Your feet are too near the eggs.
I give a hiss.
Half a step back, still in front of the nest.
The pain folds my wings.
One leg feels weak.
Blood soaks into my feathers.
I glance back at the eggs.
I step back in front of the nest.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了两根，我还能护巢。
lines.en: Two feathers lost; I can still guard the nest.
I am not going to leave.
Is that fruit, or an egg?
Seeds, insects, tender leaves—I eat them all.
Leave it outside the nest.
Only when your palm is open do I dare peck.
I smell something sweet.
Step back, then I will come.
That is not enough for the clutch.
I will fetch it myself.
I do not eat eggs of my own kind.
A little further away.
I spread my wings and block you.
Move back a little.
My toes are gripping hard.
Your step sounds too loud in the sand.
I snap at the air near you.
That bump will not move me.
Do not touch my nest.
I stand in the middle and stay.

lines.zh: 我们之间保持这段距离。
lines.en: Keep this distance from me.
There are already eggs in the nest.
I am guarding this clutch.
Now is the time for guarding.
Have you come to help too?
First I must see them hatch.
The sandstorms are strong this season.
When the young have grown.
Not at a time like this.
I must get back to the nest.
You cannot understand me, can you?
A pebble by the nest.
I push it aside with my beak.
I sweep the sand aside.
This one is not from my nest.
I lower my head and pick at it.
Put it outside.
The nest must stay clean.
An egg fell loose. I'll guard it.
Do not press up to the nest.

lines.zh: 蛋就在身后，我盯着你的脚。
lines.en: The eggs are behind me. I watch your feet.
My wings have opened.
I will shield these three eggs.

lines.zh: 这是牙道赫塔的巢区，退后。
lines.en: This is Djadochta nesting ground—back off.
Get away from my nest.
Get behind the bushes.
My beak points at you.
This clutch will not be lost.
Move, and I lunge.
The sand will remember your prints.

lines.zh: 我半张翅膀，从巢里站起来。
lines.en: I half-spread my wings and rise from the nest.
I watch you from low down.
Neck straight, leaning forward.

lines.zh: 我张开颈羽，把巢挡在身后。
lines.en: I flare my neck feathers, the nest behind me.

lines.zh: 你靠近沙丘，我的喙张开了。
lines.en: As you near the dune, my beak opens.
I count your footfalls.
My wings stay spread.
The sand is hot. I do not care.
My eggs are behind me. Do not touch them.
Your left foot sinks in loose sand.
One step more and I leap.
I guard the nest. I cannot retreat.
The wind is loud.
A peck lands on your hand.
I lunge, wings beating.
A kick with my foot.
That peck was accurate.
I drive you away from the nest.
Head down, another peck.
I stand in front of the eggs.
I give a hiss.
My beak catches your sleeve.
I release and fall back.
I raise my head on the dry riverbed.
Sand still clings to my feathers.
First I find my nest.
The dunes here are tall.
The eggs are right by my feet.
I settle low.
The wind is strong. I hold.
One of my kind calls in the distance.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘后走出，尾羽扫沙。
lines.en: I step from behind the dune, tail feathers sweeping.
I sweep sand against the nest.
I check the sky. No clouds.
These eggs have not hatched.
I raise my neck.

lines.zh: 热浪把我的羽毛边缘烧卷。
lines.en: The heat curls my feather tips.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下来，吃了一嘴沙。
lines.en: I roll down the dune, mouth full of sand.

lines.zh: 水不深，可我羽毛全湿了。
lines.en: Not deep, but my feathers are soaked.
Sand is thrown over me.

lines.zh: 这光我不明白，可我知道不好。
lines.en: I do not understand this light, but I know it is bad.
Nothing to eat near the nest.
Lightning burns the sand black.
The nest and eggs are gone.
